## Step 1 — Confirm escalated perspectives
- **Keyboard & Motor Access**: HIGH
- **Screen Reader & Semantic Structure**: HIGH

---

## Step 4 & 5 — Per-Perspective Checklists & Findings

### Perspective: Keyboard & Motor Access
**Checklist Status:** 
- [x] All interactive elements reachable/operable by keyboard (Enter/Space)
- [x] No keyboard traps
- [x] Focus indicator visible (`:focus-visible` with 3px outline, ≥3:1 contrast change against adjacent)
- [ ] Arrow key navigation for grouped widget implemented

**Finding:** 
**Finding:** Tab group lacks arrow key navigation. Users can only switch tabs via click or Enter/Space on the focused button, violating standard keyboard interaction expectations for grouped widgets and creating a significant barrier for keyboard-only users.
**WCAG:** 2.1.1 Keyboard
**Perspective:** Keyboard & Motor Access
**Severity:** MAJOR
**Route to:** Front-End Dev (secondary: UX Design)
**Evidence:** `onClick={() => handleTabClick(tab.id)}` on `<button>` elements in `.tab-bar`; no `onKeyDown` handler for ArrowLeft/ArrowRight.
**Fix:** Implement an `onKeyDown` handler on tab buttons to move focus between tabs using ArrowLeft and ArrowRight keys, ensuring focus wraps or stops at boundaries per the WAI-ARIA APG Tab Panel keyboard interaction pattern.

### Perspective: Screen Reader & Semantic Structure
**Checklist Status:** 
- [x] Landmark regions present (`<section>`)
- [x] Heading hierarchy logical (`<h2>` present)
- [x] DOM order matches visual reading order
- [ ] Custom widget uses correct ARIA roles matching WAI-ARIA APG patterns (Red flag fired: auto-CRITICAL)

**Finding:** 
**Finding:** Tab widget is missing all required ARIA roles and state properties. Screen readers cannot identify the component as a tablist, individual tabs, their selected state, or how they link to content panels, completely obscuring the widget's function.
**WCAG:** 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value
**Perspective:** Screen Reader & Semantic Structure
**Severity:** CRITICAL
**Route to:** Front-End Dev (secondary: Content Author)
**Evidence:** `<div className="tab-bar">` lacks `role="tablist"`; `<button>` elements lack `role="tab"`, `aria-selected`, and `aria-controls`; panel `<div>`s lack `role="tabpanel"` and `id`.
**Fix:** Add `role="tablist"` to the tab bar container. Add `role="tab"`, `aria-selected={activeTab === tab.id}`, and `aria-controls={tab.id}` to each button. Add `role="tabpanel"` and `id={tab.id}` to each panel. Manage focus on the active tab when state changes.

---

**Component/artifact reviewed:** Tab Panel Without Arrow Key Navigation
**Perspectives escalated for deep review:** Keyboard & Motor Access (HIGH), Screen Reader & Semantic Structure (HIGH)
**Perspectives at LOW (not reviewed):** Magnification & Reflow, Environmental Contrast, Vestibular & Motion Sensitivity, Auditory Access, Cognitive & Neurodivergent
